note: Public APWRIMS dashboard data, fetched for research. Soil moisture is modelled; rainfall and reservoir figures are departmental measurements. Not an official export.

soilMoisture.source: APWRIMS soil moisture dashboard: NRSC VIC land-surface model, 0.05 degrees
soilMoisture.measure: Available soil moisture: plant-available water held to each depth, as % of what that soil can hold

baseline.rule: the same calendar day in each earlier year the portal holds

rainfall.source: APWRIMS rainfall dashboard: AP Directorate of Economics and Statistics mandal rain gauges
rainfall.normalBasis: the department's published normal for each mandal over the same window
rainfall.categoryRule: departure from normal: excess >= +20%, normal -19 to +19%, deficient -20 to -59%, scanty -60 to -99%, no rain

state.basis: area-weighted: total rainfall volume against total normal volume

reservoirs.source: APWRIMS reservoir dashboard: Water Resources Department telemetry and reports
reservoirs.releaseNote: Releases are measured where water leaves the reservoir. Which mandals a canal reaches, and how much arrives, needs the canal command-area map, which is not public.
